model: R4f underlay, top-wing assembly hidden (round4/src/ck2car_r4.py + spec410.py, Matthew-approved 2026-11-21 11:25 PM, locked). Garage only, not part of the race atlas.
heading0: nose pointing up the screen, away from the grandstand, increasing clockwise (same as the car bake)
name_pattern: car_{layer}_{heading:03d}_C_nowing  — drop-in for car_*_{h}_C in the garage when the wing closeup is shown
hide_note: Hidden: every child of top_wing (foil, sideboards, wicker, wing numbers) and the top_wing empty. Kept: slider rails, front/rear posts, stays, wing cylinder (cage-mounted). Nose wing kept. Posts stay at the locked 24.5° attachment; the front-post deck mount is the closeup tilt pivot so front posts still meet the overlay wing. Rear posts do not extend with notch.
shadow_note: Underlay shadow is the car without the top-wing assembly (posts still cast). The wing closeup atlas carries the wing-only ground shadow. Runtime combine on the car grid: density = 1 - (1-underlay)*(1-closeup_wing), then the usual 0.6 runtime alpha. Closeup shadow placement uses the closeup overlay origin, with scale 1.0 onto the 192 px / 6.8 m car frame (see wing closeup README).
lights: R4 scene, fixed for all frames: key sun 3.8 (12 deg disc) from screen upper-left ~62 deg high, two large area fill banks, sky 0.6; shadow layer = key sun only
